$description: BitFinite Wallet design tokens. W3C DTCG format — import into Figma with Tokens Studio, or feed to Style Dictionary. Every value is read from the Flutter source or measured from a device screenshot; nothing here is inferred from a mockup. Generated 2026-09-03 against bitfinite-wallet @ fd0dc919e.

hero.$description: The balance block, identical for every coin. Fixed in code as kHeroSurface, NOT theme-provided and NOT the coin colour. Chosen because white lands at 17.72:1 on it: the coin colours could not carry one shared ink, since white on Bellscoin gold measures 1.64:1.

light.$description: Transaction rows and the payouts row.

dark.$description: Transaction rows and the payouts row.

onHero.$description: Every label on the hero. Always white since the surface became neutral — heroInk() returns white unconditionally. 17.72:1 on the hero.

onHeroDisabled.$description: kInkDark. No longer used on the hero; kept for other filled surfaces where a theme's own ink fails against its background.

opacity.$description: De-emphasis steps for hero labels, applied to ink.onHero. Measured against the hero surface; every step clears AA.

heroDust.$description: the sub-coin decimal digits inside the balance

heroScrim.$description: the circular icon buttons in the app bar

coin.$description: The coin's identity colour. Since the hero went neutral these paint the coin icon, its card on the home screen, and the accents — never the balance surface.

brand.$description: Declared in code as brandColorValue. Equals Brandkit --bfx-blue-700.

themeFill.$description: DRIFT: what the theme actually paints, measured on device. Matches neither brandColorValue nor any Brandkit stop. Worth reconciling.

brand.$description: Bell Bag Gold, official. Declared and rendered agree. White is unusable on it at 1.64:1 — this is why the hero is neutral.

contrast.$description: Measured, not estimated. WCAG 2.1 relative luminance. Kept as tokens so a future colour change can be checked against the same numbers.

whiteOnBellscoin.$description: FAILS. Below even the 3:1 large-text floor.

bellscoinOnPageLight.$description: FAILS. The See all link and dock accents on the light page. Open issue.

typography.$description: Sizes as shipped. The balance came down 52 → 44 → 36 → 30 as the hero was compacted and made to scroll away.

balanceDust.$description: trailing sub-coin digits, de-emphasised via opacity.heroDust

radius.$description: Constants.size.circularBorderRadius. Cards, chips, the payouts row.

heroFootRadius.$description: The hero's bottom corners, echoing the device frame rather than inventing a second curve.

dockHeight.$description: WalletView.navBarHeight. The last list row pads itself past this.

gutter.$description: Page side padding for the list and section headers.

sparkline.$description: The price chart's drawn height. Its card is ~219px — mostly padding, price row and range pills.

layout.$description: Proportional caps that stop long numbers from crushing their labels. Pepecoin balances run to thirteen digits, which is what forced these.

rowAmountMaxWidth.$description: Share of the transaction row the amount may take. Past it the number scales down instead of eating the Sent/Received label.

payoutTotalMaxWidth.$description: Same idea on the payouts row, so the freshness and count survive.

behaviour.$description: Not visual, but they decide what a screen can show, so a designer needs them.

historyWalkCap.$description: Transactions loaded per sync. A pool address holds 45,000+, so the list is explicitly partial and says so.

balanceCompactDigits.$description: At eight or more whole digits the balance drops its sub-coin decimals: 4,946,461,530.06954205 renders as 4,946,461,530. Magnitude is never abbreviated.
